title: Isoperimetric filling of integer multiplicity cycles in positive codimension from the scaled deformation theorem (Simon 6.6.1)
statement: Assume (DTr): for all P, m ∈ ℕ with m + 1 < P there is c ∈ ℝ≥0 with c ≥ 1 such that for every ρ > 0 and every integer multiplicity T ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) (SimonGMT GeometricCurrentOn univ (m + 1)) with compact support, M(T) < ∞ and M(∂T) < ∞ there are Q, S ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) and R ∈ 𝒟_{m+2}(ℝ^P) such that Q, ∂Q and R are integer multiplicity, T − Q − S = ∂R, Q = 0 or M(Q) ≥ ρ^{m+1}, M(Q) ≤ cM(T), M(∂Q) ≤ cM(∂T), M(R) ≤ cρM(T), M(S) ≤ cρM(∂T), spt Q ∪ spt R ⊆ thickening(3√Pρ, spt T) and spt ∂Q ∪ spt S ⊆ thickening(3√Pρ, spt ∂T) (masses in [0, ∞]; this is verbatim the first conjunct of the selected node's conclusion). Then for all P, m ∈ ℕ with m + 1 < P there is a real c ≥ 1 such that every integer multiplicity Z ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) with compact support, ∂Z = 0 and M(Z) < ∞ is the boundary ∂Y of an integer multiplicity Y ∈ 𝒟_{m+2}(ℝ^P) with M(Y) ≤ c(2cz)^{1/(m+1)}z and spt Y ⊆ thickening(3√P(2cz)^{1/(m+1)}, spt Z), where z := M(Z) (real part ENNReal.toReal; the power is Real.rpow) (verbatim the second conjunct of the selected node's conclusion).
